title: Notice Period Rules in India: Can Your Employer Force You to Serve It, and How Buyout Works
seoTitle: Notice Period Rules in India: Buyout, F&F and Your Rights
seoDescription: Notice period rules in India: you can't be forced to serve, but notice pay, bond damages and relieving letters can be held. Buyout maths, GST, 2-day F&F.
excerpt: What contracts, the labour codes and recent Supreme Court and Bombay High Court rulings say about early exits, plus a basic-vs-gross buyout example, GST on notice pay and the tax impact (Form 130, formerly Form 16).
